declined.subject: data-access
declined.reason: The data-access standard governs the seam between application logic and persistent database engines (SQL query builders, table/row mappers, database transactions, CQRS read models, and multi-driver database stores), whereas console-data-layer is a frontend client network layer providing JSON-RPC execution (RpcClient), WebSocket event subscription (openEventStream), and client-side response caching/invalidation (QueryCache, useRpc, usePaged) against the local daemon.

declined.subject: data-access
declined.reason: The data-access standard governs database repository layering, query construction, row decoding, and transactional units of work for persistent database stores, whereas console-ui-primitives provides reusable frontend UI presentation components (chips, filter tables, pill groups, rate bars, switches, sections, and virtual lists) with styling and DOM virtualization, containing no database or data-access persistence mechanisms.
